import sys
import math

def nod(a, b):
    if a == 0:
        return b
    if b == 0:
        return a
    return nod(b, a % b)

def consider(candidate, den, target, best, ans):
    error = abs(candidate / den - target)
    if error < best[0]:
        ans[0] = int(candidate)
        ans[1] = den
        best[0] = error

x, y, n = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())
ans = [0, 0]

if n >= y:
    g = nod(x, y)
    ans[0] = x // g
    ans[1] = y // g
else:
    best = [1000050000.0]
    target = x / y
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        value = x * i / y
        consider(math.floor(value), i, target, best, ans)
        consider(math.ceil(value), i, target, best, ans)

print(f"{ans[0]}/{ans[1]}")
